title: How Many Days on Zanzibar?
excerpt: How many days do you need on Zanzibar? It depends on whether you want to rest, explore or both.
body:
## Three nights

Enough for rest after a safari, with one excursion.

## Four to six nights

Ideal: one night in Stone Town and a few days on the beach, with excursions.

## A week or more

For real relaxation, diving or combining two beaches.

## Our advice

Combine one night in [Stone Town](/blog/stone-town-walking-guide/) with three to five nights on the beach.

[Plan your Zanzibar stay](/travel-proposal/).
